Set up, with two caveats.

- **Gateway not running:** the job is saved but won't fire until the Hermes gateway is started (`hermes gateway start`).
- **Time zone:** the scheduler only takes UTC, so I set it to 22:30 UTC, which is 5:30pm Chicago while daylight saving time lasts. US clocks go back on Nov 1, and then it needs to be 23:30 UTC. I haven't changed it for that yet.

I also replied in the thread confirming this to you. The job is weekdays only; if it runs on a day with no new messages, it posts "No new messages in #strategic-pod today."
